SELECT BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , M.INPT_MST_SRNO , IE.FX AS FX , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IE.DT,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT , CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS CUCD , IE.OPR AS OPR , IE.CUS AS CUS , IE.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD , '10' AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD , BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS REQ_DSCD , BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM , IE.BZBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , IE.AM AS AM , IE.CSNO AS CSNO , M.FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM M , (SELECT INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , FX_ACNO AS FX , XPO_CVRG_MTBR_MK_DT AS DT , XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS CUCD , TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR , CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD , KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , XPBY_COL_AM AS AM , CSNO AS CSNO , XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS MK_SQ FROM CSPD201TM
UNION ALL
SELECT INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , FX_ACNO AS FX , TDOC_RCP_DT AS DT , TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS CUCD , TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR , CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSC , KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , TDOC_RCP_AM AS AM , CSNO AS CSNO , TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS MK_SQ FROM CSPD202TM )IE , CSPD112TI CU , CSPD112TI BIZ WHERE M.ACTL_FX_REFNO = IE.FX(+) AND M.FX_REFNO_SRNO = IE.MK_SQ (+) AND CU.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '270' AND CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = IE.CUCD AND BIZ.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = IE.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND M.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '10'

SELECT BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM, NULL AS INPT_MST_SRNO, A.FX_ACNO AS FX, A.XPO_CVRG_MTBR_MK_DT AS DT, A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS CUCD, A.TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR, A.CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD, A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD, '10' AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD, BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS REQ_DSCD, BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, A.KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM, A.XPBY_COL_AM AS AM, A.CSNO AS CSNO, A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD201TM A -- 008 심사이력 테이블에서 가져올수 없는 이유는 연결할수있는 조건 컬럼값이 없음 (예를들으 Reference Number) -- , CSPD112TI CU , CSPD112TI BIZ WHERE CU.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '270' AND CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AND BIZ.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT B.FX FROM ( SELECT ACTL_FX_REFNO AS FX ,FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM ) B WHERE B.FX = A.FX_ACNO AND B.FX_REFNO_SRNO = A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ )
UNION ALL
SELECT BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM, NULL AS INPT_MST_SRNO, A.FX_ACNO AS FX, A.TDOC_RCP_DT AS DT, CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS CUCD, A.TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR, A.CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD, A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD, '10' AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD, BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS REQ_DSCD, BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, A.KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM, A.TDOC_RCP_AM AS AM, A.CSNO AS CSNO, A.TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD202TM A , CSPD112TI CU , CSPD112TI BIZ --, CSPD001TM M
WHERE CU.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '270' AND CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= A.TDOC_RCP_CUCD AND BIZ.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD --AND M.ACTL_FX_REFNO (+)= A.FX_ACNO --AND M.FX_REFNO_SRNO (+)= A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT B.FX FROM ( SELECT ACTL_FX_REFNO AS FX FROM CSPD001TM ) B WHERE B.FX = A.FX_ACNO )

SELECT BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , M.INPT_MST_SRNO , IE.FX AS FX , IE.DT AS DT
, CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS CUCD , IE.OPR AS OPR , IE.CUS AS CUS , IE.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD , IE.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD as INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD , '60' AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD , BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS REQ_DSCD , BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM , IE.BZBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , IE.AM AS AM , IE.CSNO AS CSNO , TO_NUMBER(M.FX_REFNO_SRNO) AS FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM M , (SELECT INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , FX_ACNO AS FX , XPO_CVRG_MTBR_MK_DT AS DT , XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS CUCD , TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR , CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSCD , INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD , KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , XPBY_COL_AM AS AM , CSNO AS CSNO , XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS MK_SQ FROM CSPD201TM
UNION ALL
SELECT INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , FX_ACNO AS FX , TDOC_RCP_DT AS DT , TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS CUCD , TRN_OPR_NO AS OPR , CUS_KORL_NM AS CUS , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS BIZ_DSC , INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD , KRBR_NM AS BZBR_NM , TDOC_RCP_AM AS AM , CSNO AS CSNO , TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS MK_SQ FROM CSPD202TM )IE , CSPD112TI CU , CSPD112TI BIZ WHERE M.ACTL_FX_REFNO = IE.FX(+) AND M.FX_REFNO_SRNO = IE.MK_SQ (+) AND CU.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '270' AND CU.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = IE.CUCD AND BIZ.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND BIZ.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = IE.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN = 'Y' AND M.PAPS_RE_SCAN_CMPL_YN IS NULL
